questions.question: Varun and Raju, working together, can complete a job in 40 hours whereas Varun alone can complete the same job in 50 hours. The number of hours required by Raju to complete the job alone is:
questions.questionHtml: Varun and Raju, working together, can complete a job in 40 hours whereas Varun alone can complete the same job in 50 hours. The number of hours required by Raju to complete the job alone is:
questions.solution:
Work rate of Varun and Raju together = 1/40

Work rate of Varun alone = 1/50

Work rate of Raju alone = 1/R

⇒ 1/40 = 1/50 + 1/R

⇒ 10/2000 = 1/R ⇒ R = 200 hours.

questions.question: The marked price of an electronic watch in a store is ₹15,620 and it is available at a discount of 27%. What is the price (in ₹, to the nearest tens) that a customer pays if he buys from the store?
questions.questionHtml: The marked price of an electronic watch in a store is ₹15,620 and it is available at a discount of 27%. What is the price (in ₹, to the nearest tens) that a customer pays if he buys from the store?
questions.solution:
Discount amount = 0.27 × 15,620 = ₹4,217.4

Price after discount = 15,620 - 4,217.4 = ₹11,402.6 ≈ ₹11,400

questions.question: \(\text{If } p = \frac{\sin A}{1 + \cos A}, \text{ then } \frac{\sin A}{1 - \cos A} \text{ is equal to:}\)
questions.questionHtml: \(\text{If } p = \frac{\sin A}{1 + \cos A}, \text{ then } \frac{\sin A}{1 - \cos A} \text{ is equal to:}\)
questions.solution:
p = (sin A)/(1 + cos A)

⇒ (sin A)/(1 - cos A) × (1 + cos A)/(1 + cos A) ⇒ (sin A(1 + cos A))/((1 - cos A)(1 + cos A))

⇒ (sin A(1 + cos A))/(sin2 A)

⇒ (1 + cos A)/(sin A) = 1/p

questions.question: Half litre of a solution contains 15% of alcohol. To change the alcohol concentration to 50%, find the quantity of alcohol to be mixed.
questions.questionHtml: Half litre of a solution contains 15% of alcohol. To change the alcohol concentration to 50%, find the quantity of alcohol to be mixed.
questions.solution:
Existing alcohol = 0.15 × 500 = 75 ml, Desired concentration = 50%

⇒ (75 + x) / (500 + x) = 0.50

⇒ 75 + x = 250 + 0.50x = x = 350 ml

questions.question: The side BC of ∆ABC is produced to a point D. If AC = BC and ∠BAC = 70º, then find the value of 2.5∠ACD - 1.5∠ABC
questions.questionHtml: The side BC of ∆ABC is produced to a point D. If AC = BC and ∠BAC = 70º, then find the value of 2.5∠ACD - 1.5∠ABC
questions.solution:
⇒ AC = BC, ∠BAC = 70º

⇒ ∠ABC = 70º, ∠ACD = 140º

⇒ 2.5∠ACD - 1.5∠ABC = 2.5 × 140º - 1.5 × 70º = 245º

questions.question: If 8cotθ = 7, then the value of \(\frac{1+sin \theta}{cos\theta}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If 8cotθ = 7, then the value of \(\frac{1+sin \theta}{cos\theta}\) is:
questions.solution:
cotθ = 7/8

Hypotenuse = √(82 + 72) = √113

⇒ (1 + sinθ)/(cosθ) = (1 + 8/√113)/(7/√113) = (8 + √113)/7

questions.question: In Δ ABC, DE ∥ BC and 5AE = 3EC. If AB = 6.4 units, then the value of DB (in units) is:
questions.questionHtml: In Δ ABC, DE ∥ BC and 5AE = 3EC. If AB = 6.4 units, then the value of DB (in units) is:
questions.solution:
Let AE = x and EC = y, so 5x = 3y ⇒ y = (5x)/3.

In ΔADE and ΔABC: AD/AB = AE/AC, let AD = k and DB = m.

⇒ k/6.4 = x/(x + 5x/3) ⇒ k = 6.4 × 3/8 = 2.4

⇒ k + m = 6.4 ⇒ m = 4.

questions.question: If 2a - b = 3 and 8a 3 - b 3 = 999, then find the value of 4a 2 − b 2
questions.questionHtml: If 2a - b = 3 and 8a<sup>3</sup> - b<sup>3</sup> = 999, then find the value of 4a<sup>2 </sup>− b<sup>2</sup>
questions.solution:
(a - b)3 = a3 - b3 - 3ab(a - b)

⇒ 18ab = 972 ⇒ ab = 54

(2a - b)2 = 4a2 + b2 - 4ab

⇒ 4a2 + b2 = 225

(2a + b)2 = 4a2 + b2 + 4ab

⇒ 2a + b = √(225 + 216) = 21

(2a + b)(2a - b) = 4a2 - b2

∴ 4a2 - b2 = 63

questions.question: If the radius and height of a right circular cylinder are 21 cm and 5 cm, respectively, then the total surface area of the cylinder is (use \pi =(22)/(7) ):
questions.questionHtml: If the radius and height of a right circular cylinder are 21 cm and 5 cm, respectively, then the total surface area of the cylinder is (use \pi =(22)/(7) ):
questions.solution:
\(Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cylinder = 2\pi r(h + r)\)

⇒ TSA = 2 × \(\frac{22}{7}\) × 21 × (5 + 21)

⇒ TSA = 3432 cm2

questions.question: In a circle with center O, an arc ABC subtends an angle of 138º at the center of the circle. The chord AB is produced to a point P. Then, the measure of ∠CBP is:
questions.questionHtml: In a circle with center O, an arc ABC subtends an angle of 138º at the center of the circle. The chord AB is produced to a point P. Then, the measure of ∠CBP is:
questions.solution:
∠ACB = ∠AOC / 2 = 138º / 2 = 69º

∠CBP = 2 × ∠ACB = 2 ×  69º = 138º

questions.question: Raman fixes the sale price of his goods at 16% above the cost price. He sells his goods at 12% less than the fixed price. Find the profit percentage correct to two places of decimal.
questions.questionHtml: Raman fixes the sale price of his goods at 16% above the cost price. He sells his goods at 12% less than the fixed price. Find the profit percentage correct to two places of decimal.
questions.solution:
Fixed Sale Price = 100 + 16% of 100 = 116

Actual Sale Price = 116 - 12% of 116 

Actual Sale Price = 102.08

Profit Percentage = (102.08 - 100) / 100 × 100 = 2.08%

questions.question: The sum of two consecutive even numbers is 174. Find the smaller number.
questions.questionHtml: The sum of two consecutive even numbers is 174. Find the smaller number.
questions.solution:
Let the smaller number be x.

⇒ x + (x + 2) = 174

⇒ 2x = 172 ⇒ x = 86

questions.question: A thief takes off on his bike at a certain speed, after seeing a police car at a distance of 250 m. The police car starts chasing the thief and catches him. If the thief runs 1.5 km before being caught and the speed of the police car is 70 km/h, then what is the speed of thief's bike (in km/h)?
questions.questionHtml: A thief takes off on his bike at a certain speed, after seeing a police car at a distance of 250 m. The police car starts chasing the thief and catches him. If the thief runs 1.5 km before being caught and the speed of the police car is 70 km/h, then what is the speed of thief's bike (in km/h)?
questions.solution:
Let thief's speed be v m/s, Time to catch thief = 1500/v seconds, Distance covered by police = 1750 m

⇒ Time by police to cover 1750 m = 1750/(350/18) = 90 s

⇒ Since times are equal: 1500/v = 90 ⇒ v = 16.67 m/s = 60 km/h.

questions.question: Suresh's expenditure and savings are in the ratio of 3 : 1. His income increases by 25%. If his savings increase by 20%, then by how much percentage does his expenditure increase?
questions.questionHtml: Suresh's expenditure and savings are in the ratio of 3 : 1. His income increases by 25%. If his savings increase by 20%, then by how much percentage does his expenditure increase?
questions.solution:
Let original income be 4x. Expenditure = 3x, Savings = x.

New income = 4x + 25%(4x) = 5x 

New savings = x + 20%(x) = 1.2x.

New expenditure = 5x - 1.2x = 3.8x.

Percentage increase in expenditure = [(3.8x - 3x) / 3x] × 100 = 262/3%.
